mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of the months when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% signals an impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors flee risk.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts below 630 thousand units and retail sales below $400 billion indicates a sharp contraction in consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of the instances when both HOUST < 630 and RSAFS < 400000.

mechanism_narrative: In a low industrial production regime (INDPRO < 95), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to declining manufacturing output and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: In a high consumer spending regime (RSAFS > 400 billion), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to strong corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of the instances when RSAFS > 400000.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 225) signals the Federal Reserve may tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 60% of the instances when CPIAUCSL > 225.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225) indicates a 'stagflation' scenario, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 225.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 8.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.
